part.text:
Implemented the fix in `tokio-util/src/time/delay_queue.rs`.

When removing the last queued item clears the timer, `DelayQueue` now wakes any task waiting in `poll_expired`, allowing it to observe `Poll::Ready(None)`. This covers both `remove` and `try_remove`.

Validation: `cargo test -p tokio-util --features full` — all tests passed, including `wake_after_remove_last`.
